blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.
blocks.zh: 假面语言模型(MLMs),如BERT,通常用于代表学习,尽管其取消预训。 我们测试这种能力是否支持不经过传播培训的有条件生成。 我们的解码器反复预测被遮住的活物,并使用同位素时间表进行高自信的预测. 它不需要扩散时间步或逆向扩散目标。 冰冻的BERT已经显示出很大的解密能力,重建了61.0%、37.5%和24.4%的蒙面标志,分别是15%、45%和60%的腐败,尽管随着可见环境的消失,世代急剧恶化。 这种能力本身并不产生任务导向生成:冷冻BERT在ARC-Easy上只达到11.0%,在MMLU上达到4.2%. 然而,普通的MLM适应能将同一种架构迅速转换为可使用的生成器. 全面适应分别达到28.2%和24.6%,而参数效率高的适应大幅减少了未匹配的产出。 在无限制的有条件生成时,完全的MLM适应在QQP上达到0.1663/0.583的BLEU/ROUGE-L,在Quasar-T上达到0.107/0.327的BLEU/ROUGE-L,将其置于与公布的BERT模型相同的广泛性能范围,通过传播培训而未经过明确的传播培训. 最后,将同样的基因界面应用于更强的被遮掩的表达方式,大大提高了性能:RoBERTa-大在ARC-Easy上达到44.2%,在MMLU上达到33.8%. 这些结果将蒙面迭代生成的三个组成部分分开:预训提供表示和去名接线员,任务调整决定模型生成什么,迭代承诺规则提供解码过程. 因此,在此处研究的环境下,不需要通过事先经过培训的MLM进行明确的传播培训,以获得有效的迭代条件生成。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT [ 4 ] are typically treated as representation models rather than generators. Their pretraining objective reconstructs tokens removed from otherwise observed text, producing bidirectional representations that have proved effective across classification, retrieval, and structured prediction tasks [ 6 ] . In contrast, modern text generation is dominated by autoregressive models and, more recently, by diffusion-based approaches that formulate generation as iterative denoising.
blocks.zh: BERT[4]等蒙面语言模型通常被视为代表模型,而不是生成物。 其预训目标重建了从其他观测到的文本中移除的符号,产生双向表达,在分类、检索和结构化预测任务中证明是有效的[6]。 相比之下,现代文本生成以自动递减模型为主,而最近则以传播为基础的方法将生成形成迭代去诺化.

blocks.en: The distinction is less clear than this division of labour suggests. A MLM is already trained to map corrupted language back toward clean language. It is then reasonable to assume that its pretrained denoising operator might already contain enough of the machinery that generation requires. If the model is repeatedly applied while its most confident predictions are progressively inserted into the context, masked-token prediction itself defines an iterative generation procedure.
blocks.zh: 区别不如这种分工所暗示的那么明确。 已经训练了一个MLM将腐烂的语言映射回干净的语言. 因此,可以合理地假定,其事先受过训练的去诺操作员可能已经含有足够多的生成所需的机械。 如果该模型被反复应用,同时其最自信的预测被逐步插入上下文,遮掩式的预测本身就定义了一个迭代生成程序.

and discrete diffusion [ 8 ] . This raises a more basic
question: how much additional generative machinery is required once a
pretrained masked language model already exists?

blocks.en:
We investigate this question by deliberately removing the diffusion machinery.
Starting from ordinary pretrained BERT-family MLMs, we introduce no forward
diffusion process, reverse diffusion parameterization, timestep embedding, or
learned noise schedule. Instead, generation consists of repeated MLM
evaluation followed by a simple external commitment schedule. At each
iteration, the model predicts all unresolved target positions, the
highest-confidence predictions are committed, and the remaining positions
stay masked for the next pass. Once committed, tokens are never remasked. The
result is a monotonic iterative decoder built directly around the pretrained
MLM.

Finally, we ask what determines the competence of the resulting generator.
Frozen pseudo-log-likelihood controls reveal no large hidden
multiple-choice capability in BERT-base that is merely inaccessible to the
iterative decoder. Instead, replacing the underlying masked representation
changes generative performance substantially. BERT-large provides only a
modest gain over BERT-base, whereas RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy
and 33.8% on MMLU under the same generative framework. Because BERT-large
and RoBERTa-large are similar in parameter scale, this comparison indicates
that generative competence depends strongly on the quality of the underlying
masked representation rather than model size alone.

blocks.en:
Taken together, the results support a simple account of how pretrained MLMs
become generators. MLM pretraining supplies both the underlying representation
and a conditional denoising operator. Task-specific MLM adaptation aligns
these with the desired output, while an iterative commitment rule converts
repeated applications of the denoising operator into a decoding process.
The quality of the pretrained representation, in turn, constrains the
competence that the resulting generator can express. Our contributions are therefore fourfold: • We show that substantial iterative denoising is already present in
frozen BERT and characterize how it degrades as visible context is
progressively removed. • We demonstrate that denoising capability and task-directed
generation are empirically separable: frozen BERT is a useful denoiser
but a poor task-conditioned generator, while ordinary MLM adaptation
cheaply converts the same architecture into a usable generative
interface. • We show that standard MLM adaptation and simple iterative decoding
can reach the performance range of an explicitly trained masked-diffusion
model on conditional generation, without a diffusion objective, timestep
conditioning, or diffusion sampling process. • We show that the competence of the resulting generator tracks the
underlying masked representation: stronger pretrained representations
produce substantially stronger generators under essentially the same
decoding procedure.

blocks.en:
These findings narrow the role that must be assigned to explicit diffusion
training in masked text generation. They do not imply that diffusion provides
no additional benefits: probabilistic modelling, diversity, unconditional
generation, and alternative sampling behaviour remain distinct questions.
Rather, they show that the basic ingredients required for effective iterative conditional generation can already be latent in a pretrained masked
language model. In this regime, generation can be obtained by exposing and
adapting an existing denoising capability rather than by learning the
denoising process anew.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work sits at the intersection of three lines of research: masked language models as generative models, discrete diffusion for language, and recent attempts to simplify masked diffusion toward ordinary masked modelling.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作位于三行研究的交汇点:蒙面语言模型作为基因模型,语言的离散扩散,以及最近简化蒙面扩散到普通蒙面模型的尝试.

blocks.en: 2.1 BERT and Masked Language Models as Generative Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 BERT和蒙面语言模型作为基因模型

blocks.en: BERT [ 4 ] was introduced primarily as a bidirectional representation model trained with a masked language modelling objective. Although it is not autoregressive, its conditional token distributions can still define a generative procedure. Wang and Cho [ 17 ] formalized BERT as a Markov random field and showed that sentences can be sampled by repeatedly masking and resampling individual tokens. Their result established that masked language models are not intrinsically restricted to discriminative use.
blocks.zh: BERT[4]主要作为双向的表示模型被引入,训练有蒙蔽的语言建模目标. 虽然它不是自递的,但其有条件的代号分布仍然可以定义基因程序. Wang and Cho [17] 将BERT形式化为Markov随机场,并显示句子可以通过反复遮盖和重新标注单个符号来取样. 其结果确定,蒙面语言模式本身并不限于歧视性使用。

blocks.en: Subsequent work has developed iterative generation methods based on masked prediction. Mask-Predict [ 7 ] introduced confidence-guided iterative refinement for conditional sequence generation, while SUNDAE [ 16 ] investigated text generation through repeated denoising. These approaches demonstrate that masked prediction can support non-autoregressive generation, although their training and decoding procedures differ from those of pretrained BERT. Our work instead examines how much of this capability is already present in an existing MLM and how much additional adaptation is required to exploit it.
blocks.zh: 随后的工作基于蒙蔽的预测,开发了迭代生成方法. Mask-President [7] 为有条件的序列生成引入了信任制导的迭代改进,而SUNDAE [16]则通过反复去诺来调查文本生成. 这些方法表明,蒙蔽的预测可以支持非自动生成,尽管其培训和解码程序与预先训练的BERT不同. 相反,我们的工作是审查现有多边清单中已经存在多少这种能力,以及利用这种能力还需要多少额外的适应。

blocks.en: More recently, Clavié et al. [ 3 ] introduced ModernBERT-Large-Instruct, a 0.4B-parameter encoder model that uses its MLM head for instruction-tuned generative classification. The model demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on classification and knowledge-based tasks, illustrating that pretrained masked representations can support task-directed outputs without a conventional classification head. Their approach focuses on single-token answers, whereas we investigate iterative multi-token generation.
blocks.zh: 最近,Clavié et al. [3]引入了ModernBERT-Large-Instruct(英语:ModernBERT-Large-Instruct),这是一种0.4B参数编码器模型,使用它的MLM头进行指令调制基因分类. 该模型显示,在分类和知识任务方面有强大的零镜头性能,说明事先经过训练的蒙面表示可以在没有常规分类主管的情况下支持任务导向的产出。 他们的方法侧重于单键答案, 而我们调查迭代多键一代。

blocks.en: 2.2 Discrete Diffusion Models for Language
blocks.zh: 2.2 语言分散传播模式

blocks.en: Diffusion models provide a probabilistic framework in which generation is defined through reversal of a progressively destructive forward process. While early diffusion models were developed primarily for continuous data, discrete variants extended the framework to categorical state spaces [ 1 ] . For language, discrete diffusion is attractive because corruption can be represented directly through token replacement or absorbing mask states.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型提供了一个概率框架,通过逆转逐渐破坏性的前进过程来界定世代。 虽然早期传播模型主要是为连续数据开发的,但离散变体将框架扩展到绝对状态空间[1]. 就语言而言,分散的传播具有吸引力,因为腐败可以通过象征性的替换或吸收面具状态直接加以体现。

blocks.en: DiffusionBERT [ 8 ] is the most direct precursor to our work. It combines pretrained BERT with an absorbing-state discrete diffusion process, motivated by the shared denoising structure of MLM pretraining and diffusion. The model learns a reverse diffusion process and investigates explicit timestep designs together with a token-frequency-dependent spindle noise schedule. For conditional generation, DiffusionBERT performs partial denoising conditioned on visible source text. Its results demonstrate that pretrained BERT provides an effective initialization for discrete diffusion and substantially accelerates convergence.
blocks.zh: 传播BERT[8]是我们工作最直接的前奏. 它将预先训练的BERT与吸收状态的离散扩散过程相结合,其动力是MLM预训和传播的共同去诺化结构. 该模型学习了反向扩散过程,并调查了明确的时间步设计,同时研究了一个信号频率依赖的旋盘噪声表. 对于有条件的生成,DifmusionBERT在可见源文本上进行部分去诺化. 其结果表明,经过预先培训的BERT为分散传播提供了有效的初始化,并大大加速了趋同。

blocks.en: Our work starts from the same empirical observation; i.e., that BERT is already a pretrained denoiser, but tests a different hypothesis. Instead of asking how best to adapt BERT into a diffusion model, we ask whether a diffusion model is necessary for the conditional-generation setting at all. We therefore remove the explicit forward process, reverse diffusion parameterization, timestep conditioning, and noise schedule, retaining only repeated MLM prediction and an external commitment schedule.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作是从同样的经验观察开始的;即BERT已经是一个预先训练的德诺瓦人,但测试的是不同的假设. 我们不问如何最好地将BERT改造为扩散模型,而是问扩散模型对于有条件的生成环境是否必要。 因此,我们取消了明确的前进过程、反向扩散参数化、时间步调调节和噪音时间表,只保留重复的MLM预测和外部承诺时间表。

blocks.en: Other discrete diffusion approaches pursue more general generative modelling objectives. Score-Entropy Discrete Diffusion (SEDD), for example, learns discrete score ratios using a score-entropy objective and achieves competitive language modelling performance relative to autoregressive baselines [ 12 ] . These approaches demonstrate that discrete diffusion can be a competitive generative paradigm in its own right. Our aim is narrower: we test whether pretrained masked language models already contain enough of the relevant denoising structure that a substantially simpler adaptation procedure suffices for conditional generation.
blocks.zh: 其他分散的传播方法追求更普遍的基因建模目标。 例如,分数-Entropy Discrete Difusion(SEDD),使用分数-Entropy目标来学习离散分数比,相对于自递性基线实现竞争性语言建模性能[12]. 这些办法表明,离散扩散本身可以成为具有竞争力的遗传范式。 我们的目标更窄:我们测试预先训练过的蒙面语言模型是否已经包含足够的相关去声结构,以至于一个基本简单的适应程序足以有条件生成。

blocks.en: 2.3 Masked Diffusion and Classical MLM Objectives
blocks.zh: 2.3 蒙面扩散和经典MLM 目标

blocks.en: Recent work has further narrowed the conceptual gap between masked diffusion and classical masked language modelling. Sahoo et al. [ 14 ] derive a simplified masked diffusion objective whose training loss can be expressed as a mixture of classical MLM losses. Their Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) achieves strong language-modelling performance and shows that encoder-only masked models can support efficient generative samplers.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作进一步缩小了蒙面传播与古典蒙面语言建模之间的概念差距. 萨虎等. [14] 得出一个简化的蒙面扩散目标,其训练损失可以表示为传统MLM损失的混合. 他们的蒙面扩散语言模型(MDLM)实现了强大的语言模型化性能,并显示只有编码器的蒙面模型可以支持高效的基因样本.

blocks.en: Related theoretical work argues that masked diffusion models can be time-agnostic: under suitable formulations, both training and sampling can be expressed without an explicit diffusion-time variable, making masked diffusion closely related to ordinary masked models [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 相关理论工作认为,蒙面扩散模型可以是时间不可知的:在合适的配方下,培训和采样都可以在没有明确的传播时间变量的情况下表达,使蒙面扩散与普通蒙面模型密切相关[18].

blocks.en: These results are highly complementary to ours. They simplify the training objective of newly trained masked diffusion models and show that diffusion-specific structure can collapse toward masked modelling. We instead begin from models that have already undergone large-scale MLM pretraining and ask whether that existing denoising representation can be reused directly. The distinction is therefore between training a generative masked model using an MLM-like objective and retrofitting an already pretrained MLM into a conditional generator . Our experiments target the latter.
blocks.zh: 这些成果与我们的成果高度互补。 它们简化了新培训的蒙面扩散模型的培训目标,并表明扩散特有的结构可以向蒙面模拟崩溃。 相反,我们从已经经历了大规模MLM预训的模型开始,并询问是否可以直接重新使用现有的去名表示。 因此,区别在于使用类似MLM的目标培训基因遮盖模型和将已经经过预先训练的MLM改装成有条件的生成器。 我们的实验针对后者。

blocks.en: 2.4 Positioning of the Present Work
blocks.zh: 2.4 现有工作的定位

blocks.en: The literature therefore establishes several pieces of the picture independently. BERT can be sampled iteratively [ 17 ] ; confidence-guided masked refinement can support conditional generation [ 7 ] ; dedicated denoising autoencoders can generate text [ 16 ] ; and discrete diffusion can combine effectively with pretrained masked models [ 8 ] . More recent work further shows that masked diffusion objectives can simplify toward mixtures of MLM losses and may not require an explicit time variable [ 14 , 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 因此,文献独立地确定了几幅图。 BERT可以进行迭代采样[17];置信制导的蒙面改进可以支持有条件的生成[7];专用的去诺化自动编码器可以生成文本[16];离散扩散可以与预先训练的蒙面模型有效结合[8]. 最近的工作进一步表明,掩盖的传播目标可以简化MLM损失的混合物,而可能不需要明确的时间变量[14、18]。

blocks.en: Our contribution is to connect these observations through a direct empirical minimality test. We characterize the denoising capability already present in frozen BERT, show that this capability is distinct from task-directed generation, demonstrate that standard MLM adaptation plus iterative decoding is sufficient to acquire useful conditional generation, and show that the quality of the resulting generator tracks the competence of the underlying masked representation. In this sense, the question addressed here is not whether masked or diffusion models can generate language, but how much additional generative machinery is actually required once a pretrained MLM already exists.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是通过直接的经验性最小度测试来将这些观察联系起来。 我们描述冻结的BERT中已经存在的消音能力,表明这种能力不同于任务导向生成,表明标准的MLM适应加迭代解码足以获得有用的有条件生成,并表明由此产生的生成器的质量跟踪了基本遮掩代表的能力. 从这个意义上讲,这里讨论的问题不是蒙面模型或扩散模型是否能够产生语言,而是一旦预先训练的MLM已经存在,实际需要多少额外的基因机械.

blocks.en: 4.5 Summary
blocks.zh: 4.5 总结

blocks.en:
Across the experiments, frozen BERT demonstrates
substantial iterative denoising capability, but
task-conditioned generation requires adaptation.
Ordinary MLM fine-tuning makes this capability
usable for multiple-choice and open-ended
generation, while stronger pretrained
representations produce stronger generators
under the same decoding procedure.

大量迭代发音能力,但
需要适应任务的生成。

生成,同时加强预训
显示器产生更强大的发电机
根据同样的解码程序。

blocks.en:
Together, the results support the view that
pretrained MLMs already supply the conditional
denoising operator needed for iterative
generation. Task adaptation aligns this
operator with the desired outputs, and
confidence-guided commitment provides a
simple mechanism for constructing complete
sequences.

具有预期产出的操作员,以及
以信任为指导的承诺

顺序。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Our results suggest that iterative conditional generation can be
decomposed into three components: a pretrained denoising operator,
task-specific adaptation, and a procedure for progressively
constructing the output. BERT already provides the first component
through masked-language-model pretraining. Ordinary MLM adaptation
can supply the task-specific behaviour, while confidence-guided
commitment turns repeated masked predictions into a completed
sequence.

我们的结果显示 迭代有条件的一代

blocks.en:
The distinction is important because denoising and task-directed
generation are different capabilities. Frozen BERT reconstructs
partially corrupted natural text effectively, yet performs poorly
when asked to generate multiple-choice answers. The pretrained
model has learned to predict missing linguistic content, but
additional adaptation is needed to produce the particular outputs
required by a task.

任务要求。

blocks.en: 5.1 From Pretrained Denoising to Generative Behaviour
blocks.zh: 5.1 从预训性生殖行为到遗传行为

blocks.en:
The reconstruction experiments establish that useful iterative
denoising is already present in pretrained BERT. This capability
depends strongly on the available context: reconstruction remains
effective under moderate corruption but deteriorates as most of
the sequence becomes masked. Conditional generation provides a
different setting, in which a visible prompt or source sequence
can supply information about the masked target.

重建仍然取决于现有环境:

blocks.en:
The adaptation experiments show that this distinction can be
exploited using the original MLM objective. Even restricted
parameter updates substantially improve multiple-choice
generation and reduce unmatched outputs. Full fine-tuning
provides further gains, but useful task-directed behaviour
emerges without retraining the complete model.
blocks.zh:

利用最初的MLM目标。 连限制
参数更新大大改进了多选择
生成并减少未匹配的产出。 完全微调
提供了更多的收益,但有益的、以任务为导向的行为
出现时没有再训练完整的模型

blocks.en:
One interpretation is that adaptation serves two related
functions. Interface adaptation makes task solutions
expressible through a masked output region, while competence adaptation modifies the representation
to improve the solutions available to that interface.
The BitFit results are consistent with the first mechanism,
whereas the additional gains from full fine-tuning suggest
a role for the second. These mechanisms are not separately
identified by the present experiments, but they provide
a useful framework for interpreting the different
adaptation regimes.

函数。 B. 接口适应是任务的解决办法
可通过蒙面输出区域表示,而能力适应则改变其代表性

适应制度。

blocks.en:
Under this interpretation, learning a conditional generator
does not necessarily require learning a new denoising
operator. A pretrained MLM may already supply that operator;
adaptation can instead establish the mapping between
conditioning information and the desired output.

blocks.en: 5.2 The Role of the Pretrained Representation
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 预先培训的代表的作用

blocks.en:
The backbone comparisons indicate that the generative
interface does not impose a fixed performance ceiling.
BERT-large provides only modest improvements over
BERT-base, whereas RoBERTa-large produces substantially
stronger results under the same iterative decoding
procedure. Because BERT-large and RoBERTa-large have
similar parameter counts, model scale alone does not
explain the observed differences.
blocks.zh:
骨干比较表明:
接口不设置固定的性能上限。
BERT大型公司仅提供少量改进。
BERT基地,而RoBERTa大型生产
在同一迭代解码下取得更大的成果
程序。 因为BERT大和RoBERTa大
类似参数计数,单是模型缩放不
解释观察到的差异。

blocks.en:
The discriminative controls provide complementary
evidence. Frozen BERT-base exhibits relatively limited
multiple-choice competence under pseudo-log-likelihood
scoring, while stronger pretrained representations
generally support stronger adapted generators.
Nevertheless, discriminative scoring and adapted
generation measure different capabilities, and their
results should not be interpreted as interchangeable.
blocks.zh:

证据。 冻结的BERT基地展品相对有限
多选择能力 假的逻辑相似
评分,同时加强预先训练的表述
通常支持更强大的改造型发电机。
然而,歧视性评分和调整
生成测量不同的能力,
结果不应被解释为可互换的。

blocks.en:
The RACE-adapted RoBERTa experiment further illustrates
the importance of the output interface. Its native
multiple-choice readout performs substantially better
than frozen iterative generation using a supplied MLM
head. Generative adaptation subsequently recovers
considerable performance. Because the supplied head
was not jointly trained with the adapted backbone,
the initial failure cannot be attributed solely to
the representation.
blocks.zh:

输出界面的重要性。 它的本土
多选择读取效果显著改善
而不是使用提供的 MLM 进行冻结迭代生成
头曰. 转基因适应随后恢复
相当出色 因为供应的头
没有与经过调整的骨干共同培训,
最初的失败不能仅仅归因于
该代表。

blocks.en:
Taken together, these findings suggest that generative
performance depends on both the information available
in the pretrained representation and the ability of
the MLM readout to express that information in the
required target format. Iterative decoding provides
the generation mechanism, but does not independently
determine the competence of the resulting model.

blocks.en: 5.3 Implications for Iterative Generation
blocks.zh: 5.3 对迭代的影响

blocks.en:
The conditional-generation results demonstrate that
ordinary MLM adaptation can support paraphrase and
question generation at a level broadly comparable
to published BERT adapted, masked-diffusion results. The comparison
with DiffusionBERT is not controlled, but it establishes
that an explicitly trained diffusion process is not
a prerequisite for obtaining this range of performance
on the evaluated tasks.
blocks.zh:
有条件生成的结果表明:
普通 MLM 适应可以支持解释和
在大致可比的层面上生成问题
以发布BERT调整后,掩盖扩散结果。 比较
与扩散BERT 不受控制,但它建立
明确培训的传播过程不是
获得这一业绩范围的前提条件
评估任务。

blocks.en:
Our decoder provides a particularly simple construction.
At each iteration, the MLM predicts unresolved positions,
and the most confident predictions are committed according
to an external schedule. The model receives no diffusion
timestep or noise-level conditioning, and committed tokens
are never remasked. Generation therefore proceeds through
repeated conditional inference with an increasingly
complete context.
blocks.zh:
我们的解码器提供了特别简单的构造.
在每次迭代, MLM 预测未解决的位置,
并且最有信心的预言,
到外部时间表。 该模型没有得到传播
时间步或噪声水平调节,以及承诺的标志
从来没有被重现。 因此,世代通过
不断重复有条件推论
完整上下文。

blocks.en:
This construction does not establish that explicit
diffusion modelling is redundant. A learned diffusion
process may offer advantages in sampling diversity,
revision of earlier predictions, output-length modelling,
or generation from weakly conditioned inputs. These
possibilities are outside the present evaluation.
The contribution here is to isolate a simpler route
to iterative conditional generation using an existing
pretrained denoiser.
blocks.zh:
这种说法并没有明确表明
扩散建模是多余的. 知识传播
工艺在取样多样性方面可能具有优势,
修订早期预测、产出长度建模、
或从条件差的投入中产生。 这些
可能性不在本次评估的范围之内。

以使用现有
预科预科生

blocks.en:
This has practical implications for the broader family
of masked language models. Many domains already possess
pretrained encoders developed from specialized corpora.
Where these models have learned useful conditional
representations, task-specific MLM adaptation and
iterative decoding may provide a route to generative
applications without training a new generative backbone
from scratch.
blocks.zh:
这对更广泛的家庭有实际影响
蒙面语言模型。 已经拥有的许多域
由专业公司开发的预训编码器。
如果这些模型学到了有用的条件
说明、针对具体任务的MLM调整和
迭代解码可能提供基因的路径
未培训新的基因主干网的应用
从零开始。

blocks.en:
The broader architectural implication is that
representation learning, task adaptation, and generation
need not be treated as a single inseparable training
problem. Their contributions can be studied and
optimized independently, even though the resulting
capabilities remain interdependent.
blocks.zh:
更广泛的建筑含义是:
代表性学习、任务适应和生成
无需将培训视为一种不可分割的单一培训
问题。 他们的贡献可以进行研究,
独立优化,即使结果
能力仍然相互依存。

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制

blocks.en:
Several limitations frame these findings. First, the experiments focus on conditional generation.
Frozen BERT deteriorates sharply at high masking ratios,
and the present results do not establish competitive
unconditional generation from a fully masked sequence.
blocks.zh:
这些结论有若干局限。 首先,实验的重点是有条件的生成.
冰冻的BERT以很高的遮盖率急剧恶化,
和目前的结果没有建立竞争性
无条件的一代 从一个完全蒙蔽的序列。

blocks.en:
Second, DiffusionBERT comparisons use published values
obtained under different training and inference
protocols. They indicate the range of achievable
conditional-generation quality but cannot establish
comparative efficiency or superiority. A controlled
comparison would require matched training data,
optimization budgets, decoding procedures, and
evaluation settings.
blocks.zh:
第二,传播BERT比较使用已公布的数值
通过不同培训和推论获得的
协议。 它们表明可实现的范围
有条件生成质量,但无法建立
相对效率或优越性。 控制
比较需要匹配的培训数据,
优化预算、解码程序
评估设置。

blocks.en:
Third, the principal multiple-choice evaluations use
fixed subsets of 500 examples. Larger evaluations
and additional tasks are needed to establish more
precise estimates of absolute performance and
generalization.
blocks.zh:
第三,主要多选择评价的使用
固定子集500例。 较大评价
需要增加任务以建立更多的
绝对业绩和
概论。

blocks.en:
Fourth, the primary multiple-choice decoder uses
reference-answer length to determine its output
budget. Fixed-length controls remove this dependency,
but a general-purpose generator should determine
output length independently. Open-ended generation
also relies on a predetermined target-length budget.

预算。 固定长度控制消除这种依赖性,
但通用发电机应确定

还依赖预定的目标期限预算。

blocks.en:
Finally, the experiments do not isolate which features
of MLM pretraining account for the observed denoising
capability, nor do they establish that confidence-based
commitment or the cosine schedule is optimal. The
present decoding procedure was chosen for simplicity
and to expose the generative capabilities of the
pretrained models.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Pretrained masked language models already contain a
useful conditional denoising operator. By combining
this capability with ordinary MLM adaptation and
confidence-guided iterative decoding, we obtain
task-conditioned generation without explicitly
training a diffusion model.
blocks.zh:
预先训练过的蒙面语言模型已经包含
实用的有条件去名操作员。 结合
这种能力与普通的MLM适应和
信心指引的迭代编码,我们得到
在不明确的情况下进行任务生成
培训一种传播模式。

blocks.en:
The experiments also establish an important boundary:
pretrained denoising alone does not guarantee useful
generation. Task adaptation is needed to direct the
model toward the required outputs, and the resulting
performance depends substantially on the quality
and accessibility of the underlying representation.
blocks.zh:
这些实验还确定了一个重要的界限:
单凭预先训练的去诺不能保证有用
生成。 需要调整任务以指导
实现所需产出的
业绩在很大程度上取决于质量
以及获得基本代表性的机会。

blocks.en:
These findings identify a lightweight route from
pretrained masked representations to iterative
conditional generation, separating the acquisition
of denoising capability from the adaptation and
decoding mechanisms used to express it.
